Why Maia

Your team already has AI. The wins are stuck in private windows.

Maia works in the Slack channel, so one good answer becomes the whole team's.

One coworker the whole team can see

Ask Maia in the thread and everyone gets the answer, the reasoning and the correction. Nobody pastes results out of a private window, and nobody starts from zero.

Any channel can have its own coworker. You get a personal one in your DM for the work that is only yours.

It acts as you, and asks before anything risky

In your apps, Maia uses your access, not a service account, so it can never do more there than you could. Reading is instant. Anything risky waits for a yes in the thread, and every run is on the record.

Read more about connectors

Context that belongs to your team

What your channel tells Maia lives in a canvas anyone can read and edit. Your terms, your rules, your exceptions, kept where the team can see them and fix them.

Never locked to one model provider

Maia reaches every major model. The ones it picks by default are open-weight, on endpoints we require to keep nothing and train on nothing. Your admin chooses which models a coworker may use, and no lab owns your coworker.

Start with one channel.

Add Maia to Slack, invite it to one channel, and ask it something. $50 in free credits, no card up front. If you would rather see it first, we will walk you through it.
